title: Estate Living w/Pool, Dogs ok/Beach VB, Game Room!
description: Welcome to our stunning 8-bedroom oasis, perfect for large groups and families! Nestled on spacious grounds, our home offers a blend of comfort and entertainment, ensuring a memorable stay for up to 27 guests.  8 tastefully decorated bedrooms with a mix of king, queen and twin-sized beds.  Fresh linens and cozy bedding for a restful night's sleep. A spacious and inviting living area with ample seating for all guests. Smart TVs for movie nights or catching up on your favorite shows.
amenities: Clothing storage: walk-in closet, closet, and dresser
Coffee maker: drip coffee maker, Keurig coffee machine
Private outdoor pool - available all year, open 24 hours, heated, pool cover, pool toys
